title: final.rule.json
description: Sidecar written beside a QorTime final. Not a receipt.v0 field. The file lives in docs/design and is not under schema/**. Pages does not publish docs/design. The publisher reads the sidecar when a review wrote one. Absence does not fail verification.

posted_score.description: Score written on an unconfirmed final. The last row of the monotone lock prefix, never a later lock that went down.

writer.description: client when the capture tail wrote the file. referee when the official re-read wrote it.

cutoff_ms.description: Null is not one meaning. Read cutoff_reason.

cutoff_reason.description: no_end_screen: cutoff_ms is null and no evidence row counts. closed_episodes_only: cutoff_ms is null and evidence outside the closed bands counts. open_episode: cutoff_ms is the integer cutoff of the episode that is still open.

episode_e0_ms.description: First end screen of the open episode, including a screen whose timestamp equals the closing lock. Null when every episode was closed, or when the capture has no end screen. Not the first end screen of the capture.

evidence_counted.description: Audit list. The only consumer of the evidence cutoff. The publisher does not render it. It does not change final_confirmed.
